<style>

<style id="phase2-css">
:root{--p2bg:#111315;--p2panel:#1c1f22;--p2line:#444b50;--p2cream:#d7d1c3;--p2red:#a83b35;--p2cyan:#71c9e8;--p2good:#a7df83}
body{background:#090a0b!important}.machine{max-width:1240px!important;padding-top:54px!important}.p2nav{position:fixed;z-index:500;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:46px;display:flex;gap:4px;padding:5px;background:#0b0d0f;border-bottom:1px solid #34393d;overflow-x:auto}.p2nav button{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:86px;height:34px;border:1px solid #555d62;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(#33383c,#1b1e21);color:#e7e9ea;font:800 11px Arial}.p2nav button.active{background:linear-gradient(#85d4ef,#438aae);color:#071015;border-color:#8be1ff}.p2view{display:none}.p2view.active{display:block}.p2toolbar{position:sticky;top:46px;z-index:30;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:7px;background:#101316eF;border:1px solid #353b40;border-radius:7px;margin:8px 0}.p2toolbar button,.p2btn,.p2toolbar select,.p2toolbar input{min-height:32px;border:1px solid #596168;border-radius:5px;background:#24282b;color:#eee;font:800 11px Arial;padding:5px 8px}.p2toolbar button.primary,.p2btn.primary{background:#438f4d;border-color:#6bc477}.p2toolbar button.stop{background:#8e332e;border-color:#cf5e56}.p2toolbar label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font:800 10px Arial;color:#d9dddf}.p2toolbar input[type=range]{padding:0;width:120px}.p2panel{margin-top:8px;background:#171a1d;border:1px solid #42484d;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;color:#e7e9ea}.p2panel h2,.p2panel h3{margin:2px 0 8px}.p2sub{color:#9ea6ab;font-size:10px;line-height:1.4}.p2status{font:800 10px/1.4 "Courier New",monospace;color:#b7c0c4;background:#0c0e0f;border:1px solid #30363a;padding:6px;border-radius:5px}.p2status.good{color:var(--p2good)}
.p2filters{display:flex;gap:5px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px}.p2filter{white-space:nowrap}.p2filter.active{outline:2px solid var(--p2cyan)}.p2browser{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:7px;margin-top:7px}.p2card{background:#0e1113;border:1px solid #394046;border-radius:7px;padding:8px}.p2card h3{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 2px}.p2card .meta{font-size:9px;color:#adb5ba}.p2card .actions{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:6px}.p2card select,.p2card button{min-height:30px;background:#22272a;color:#eee;border:1px solid #515960;border-radius:4px;font:800 10px Arial}.p2card select{width:100%;margin-top:6px}.p2card button{flex:1}.p2badge{display:inline-block;margin:4px 3px 0 0;padding:2px 5px;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:999px;font-size:8px;color:#c9d0d4}
.p2gridwrap{overflow:auto;border:1px solid #343a3f;background:#0c0e0f;border-radius:6px;margin-top:7px;max-height:52vh}.p2grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:92px repeat(32,24px);gap:2px;padding:5px;width:max-content;min-width:100%}.p2grid .lab{position:sticky;left:0;z-index:2;background:#15191b;color:#d7dcdf;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 5px;font:800 9px Arial;border-right:1px solid #495057}.p2grid .num{font:700 8px monospace;color:#6e787e;text-align:center}.p2step{width:24px;height:24px;padding:0;border:1px solid #30363a;border-radius:3px;background:#171b1e}.p2step.on{background:#ab3c36;border-color:#e0665e}.p2step.accent{background:#d36b35;border-color:#f3a05c}.p2step.playhead{outline:2px solid #dbe96c;outline-offset:-2px}.p2bar{border-left:2px solid #8f9ca3!important}
.p2mixer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:6px}.p2mixrow{background:#0d1012;border:1px solid #343a3f;border-radius:6px;padding:6px}.p2mixrow .name{font:900 10px Arial}.p2mixrow label{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr 34px;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:9px;margin-top:4px}.p2mixrow input[type=range]{width:100%}.p2mixrow button{min-height:28px;background:#252a2e;color:#eee;border:1px solid #555d62;border-radius:4px}.p2mixrow button.on{background:#78312e}.p2voices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:6px}.p2voice{background:#0d1012;border:1px solid #343a3f;border-radius:6px;padding:7px}.p2voice button{width:100%;min-height:35px;background:linear-gradient(#31363a,#171a1c);color:#eee;border:1px solid #555d62;border-radius:4px;font-weight:900}.p2legacy{width:100%;height:75vh;border:1px solid #444;background:#000}.p2modelstrip{display:flex;gap:5px;margin:5px 0}.p2modelstrip button{flex:1;min-height:34px;border:1px solid #555;background:#ddd7ca;color:#111;font-weight:900;border-radius:4px}.p2modelstrip button.real{outline:3px solid #70c8e5;outline-offset:-3px}.p2modelstrip button:disabled{opacity:.55}.p2footerNote{font-size:9px;color:#8f989d;margin-top:6px;line-height:1.4}
@media(max-width:700px){.machine{padding:52px 5px 8px!important}.top{gap:5px}.brand{font-size:30px!important}.model{font-size:20px!important}.panel{padding:6px!important}.status{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)!important}.sbox{min-height:38px!important;padding:4px!important;font-size:8px!important}.ctrlgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)!important;gap:3px!important}.ctrl{min-height:32px!important;font-size:9px!important}.pads{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)!important;gap:4px!important}.pad{min-height:52px!important;font-size:9px!important}.lcd{min-height:64px!important;padding:7px!important;font-size:18px!important}.p2toolbar{top:46px}.p2browser{grid-template-columns:1fr}.p2gridwrap{max-height:48vh}.p2legacy{height:72vh}}

<style id="phase3-machine-css">
body[data-fwmodel="hr16"]{--case:#d7d1c3;--lcd:#a9b99b;--lcdink:#17261b}
body[data-fwmodel="hr16b"]{--case:#35393c;--lcd:#d6a44a;--lcdink:#211708;color:#eee}

body[data-fwmodel="hr16b"] .ctrl,body[data-fwmodel="sr16"] .ctrl{background:#41474b;color:#eee;border-color:#090a0b;box-shadow:0 2px 0 #121416}

</style>
<style>
/* Analogue Poly — integrated synth surface; existing firmware screens untouched */
.sy-view{color:#e6e9e8;background:#13171b;border:1px solid #3c4347;border-radius:9px;padding:12px;margin:8px 0 16px;--sy-accent:#e3b16a;--sy-dark:#1c2226;}
.sy-view button,.sy-view select{border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #626b70;background:linear-gradient(#40474b,#22292c);color:#f1f1ed;padding:8px 10px;font:700 12px Arial;min-height:35px;cursor:pointer;}
.sy-view button:active{filter:brightness(1.25)}.sy-view button.sy-active{background:#d09b4d;border-color:#e5ba74;color:#121518;}
.sy-topline{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #464d4f;padding-bottom:10px;}
.sy-heading{font-size:clamp(22px,4vw,31px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--sy-accent)}.sy-tag{font:700 11px/1.4 Consolas,monospace;color:#9da9aa;flex:1;min-width:160px}
.sy-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center}.sy-actions select{max-width:180px}.sy-status{color:#b7c2bd;font:700 11px/1.4 Consolas,monospace;padding:6px 0 10px;}
.sy-panelrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.sy-panel{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#252b2f,#1a2024);border:1px solid #485157;border-radius:6px;padding:10px;min-width:0;}
.sy-panel h3{margin:0 0 10px;font:900 13px/1 Arial;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--sy-accent);border-bottom:1px solid #424d50;padding-bottom:7px}
.sy-knobs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px 16px;}
.sy-control{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;min-width:0}.sy-control span{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;align-items:center;font:700 10px Arial;color:#d8e0dd;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.sy-control output{font:700 11px Consolas,monospace;color:var(--sy-accent);white-space:nowrap;}
.sy-control select{width:100%;min-width:0;font-size:12px}.sy-control input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:var(--sy-accent);min-height:23px;cursor:ew-resize;margin:0;}
.sy-control input[type=checkbox]{width:20px;height:20px;accent-color:var(--sy-accent)}
.sy-keypanel{background:#11171a;border:1px solid #495257;border-radius:6px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:10px}.sy-keyheader,.sy-seqheader{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px}.sy-keyheader h3,.sy-seqheader h3{font:900 13px Arial;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--sy-accent);margin:0}.sy-kbdhelp{font:700 10px Consolas,monospace;color:#9ca9a8}.sy-keycontrols{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}.sy-keycontrols b{font:900 13px Consolas,monospace;min-width:44px;text-align:center}
.sy-keyscroll{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;max-width:100%;background:#0b0d0e;border-radius:4px;padding:6px;}.sy-keys{height:146px;min-width:665px;display:flex;position:relative;touch-action:none;user-select:none;}.sy-key{position:absolute;top:0;touch-action:none;user-select:none;cursor:pointer;box-sizing:border-box;}
.sy-key.white{width:4.75%;height:146px;background:linear-gradient(#fffefa,#e9e5d9 70%,#b5afa3);border:1px solid #191d1f;border-bottom:5px solid #85827c;border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;color:#232629;z-index:1;}.sy-key.black{width:3.1%;height:91px;background:linear-gradient(#444b50 0%,#0c0f10 67%);border:1px solid #020404;border-bottom:5px solid #050607;border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;z-index:2;color:#eee;}
.sy-key.pressed.white{background:linear-gradient(#ffddb3,#db9b54);border-bottom:2px solid #91551b}.sy-key.pressed.black{background:linear-gradient(#c48641,#623817);border-bottom:2px solid #44250c}
.sy-key-label{position:absolute;bottom:9px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font:800 10px Consolas,monospace;pointer-events:none}
.sy-seqpanel{background:#1c2327;border:1px solid #434d54;border-radius:6px;padding:10px;}.sy-seqheader .sy-actions select{font-size:11px}.sy-seqscroll{overflow:auto;max-height:420px;border:1px solid #343f45;border-radius:4px;background:#101719;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}.sy-grid{display:grid;gap:2px;padding:4px;width:max-content;align-items:stretch;}.sy-note{color:#d1d9d7;background:#222c30;font:800 10px Consolas,monospace;position:sticky;left:0;z-index:4;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:22px;border-right:1px solid #63727a}.sy-note.root{background:#405059;color:#f7f1e2}.sy-stepnumber{text-align:center;color:#c8d1cc;font:800 10px Consolas,monospace;min-height:17px;padding:2px 0}.sy-cell{padding:0!important;min-height:22px!important;height:22px!important;min-width:25px!important;width:25px!important;border:1px solid #3a4548!important;background:#242f34!important;box-shadow:none!important;border-radius:2px!important;}.sy-cell.beat{border-left:2px solid #718084!important}.sy-cell.on{background:#d1a059!important;border-color:#e2b677!important}.sy-cell.playhead{outline:2px solid #b7dfff;outline-offset:-2px;}.sy-stepnumber.playhead{color:#aadaff}.sy-seqfoot{margin-top:7px;font:700 10px/1.5 Consolas,monospace;color:#9ea9aa}.sy-transport{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-bottom:10px}.sy-transport .sy-bpm{font:700 12px Consolas,monospace;color:#d5dedd;margin-left:4px}.sy-rec{color:#efb6b1!important;border-color:#af635c!important}.sy-rec.sy-active{background:#a54843!important;color:#fff!important;}
@media(max-width:680px){.sy-panelrow{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sy-view{padding:8px}.sy-knobs{gap:9px 10px}.sy-topline{gap:6px}.sy-status{font-size:10px}.sy-keys{min-width:685px}.sy-panel{padding:9px}.sy-actions button{padding:6px 7px;min-height:32px;}.sy-keyscroll{padding:3px}}

.sy-bankbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;align-items:center;background:#171d20;border:1px solid #48545a;border-radius:6px;padding:7px;margin-bottom:9px;font:800 10px Arial}.sy-bankbar label{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}.sy-bankbar select{min-width:44px}.sy-bankbar input{max-width:180px;min-width:105px;background:#e4e5de;color:#171b1e;border:1px solid #849094;border-radius:4px;padding:8px;font:600 12px Arial}.sy-bankbar span{color:#a7b4ac}.sy-bankbar button{min-height:33px}@media(max-width:680px){.sy-bankbar input{max-width:132px}.sy-bankbar{gap:5px}}
</style>

<style id="phase7-style">
.p7-padslot{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}.p7-padslot>.pad{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:68px;flex:1}
.p7-choose{display:block;width:100%;max-width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:38px;border:1px solid #79838a;border-radius:4px;background:#263038;color:#eef4f4;padding:4px;font:800 10px/1.2 Arial;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.p7-choose.custom{border-color:#c3a36e;background:#3b3225;color:#ffe2aa}
.p7-choose:focus-visible,.p7-option:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #8bd7ed;outline-offset:2px}
.p7-rowlab{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:3px;min-width:94px}
.p7-rowlab .p7-choose{font-size:9px;min-height:30px;width:48px;max-width:48px}
.p7-picker[hidden]{display:none!important}.p7-picker{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:990;background:rgba(0,0,0,.82);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px}
.p7-picker-card{width:min(100%,620px);max-height:min(85vh,840px);overflow:auto;background:#171d21;border:2px solid #7b8a91;border-radius:10px;padding:12px;color:#e9eff0;font:13px Arial;box-shadow:0 16px 45px #000}
.p7-picker-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px}.p7-picker h2{margin:0;font-size:19px}.p7-picker small{font-size:11px;color:#a9bcc6;line-height:1.6}.p7-close,.p7-option button{min-height:38px;padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid #617784;border-radius:5px;background:#26363e;color:#f3f7f9;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.p7-options{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}.p7-option{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 76px 72px;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:8px;background:#232b2f;border:1px solid #39464d;border-radius:5px}.p7-option.selected{border-color:#a9d8e7;background:#293a40}.p7-option-info b{display:block;font-size:13px}.p7-option-info span{font-size:10px;color:#bbc9d0;line-height:1.6}.p7-option button.p7-use{background:#376142;border-color:#6fb57d}.p7-option.selected button.p7-use{background:#406176}.p7-summary{padding:7px;background:#0b1115;border-radius:5px;margin:8px 0 10px;line-height:1.5;font-size:12px}
.p7-voice-label{font-size:9px;color:#a6c5d4;margin-top:4px;text-align:center;min-height:20px}
.p2voice .p7-choose{margin-top:5px}
.p7-padslot .p7-voice-label{display:none}
@media(max-width:700px){.p7-padslot>.pad{min-height:62px;font-size:10px}.p7-padslot .p7-choose{min-height:36px;font-size:9px}.p7-picker{padding:5px}.p7-picker-card{padding:9px;max-height:90vh}.p7-option{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 62px 60px;gap:5px;padding:6px}.p7-option button{font-size:10px;padding:6px 3px}.p7-picker h2{font-size:17px}}
</style>
</head><body><div class="machine"><div class="top"><div><div class="brand">ALESIS</div><div class="tiny">REAL 80C31 FIRMWARE EXECUTION • THREE MACHINE CORE</div></div><div class="model" id="machineModel">HR-16<div class="tiny" id="machineOS">OS v1.09</div></div></div><div class="p2nav" id="p2nav"></div><section class="p2view active" data-p2view="machine"><div class="p2modelstrip"><button class="real" data-machine="hr16">HR-16 • REAL FW</button><button data-machine="hr16b">HR-16B • REAL FW</button><button data-machine="sr16">SR-16 • REAL FW</button></div><div class="panel"><div class="lcdframe"><div class="lcd"><div id="lcd0">                </div><div id="lcd1">                </div></div></div><div class="ledrow" id="ledrow"></div><div class="status"><div class="sbox">CPU<br><span id="cpuStat" class="warn">BOOTING 80C31</span></div><div class="sbox">CLOCK<br><span class="good">12 MHz / 1 MHz MC</span></div><div class="sbox">OS<br><span class="good" id="osStat">V1.09 CRC a9bdbf20</span></div><div class="sbox">AUDIO<br><span id="audStat" class="warn">TAP CONTROL TO UNLOCK</span></div></div><div class="ctrlgrid" id="controls"></div><div class="pads" id="pads"></div><div class="sliderbox">SELECT SLIDER <input id="slider" type="range" min="0" max="255" value="0"><b id="sliderv">0</b><button class="reset" id="resetBtn">HARD RESET</button></div><div class="debug" id="debug">CPU reset vector → real HR-16 v1.09 firmware</div><div class="note">Firmware owns the machine: keypad scanning, LCD writes, LEDs, NVRAM access and 5-byte DM3AG commands all come from the original OS. Sound starts only when the firmware writes a real DM3AG command. U16/U15 are the original supplied HR-16 sound EPROMs (8e103536 / 82e9b78c). Volume/pan/tune bits that remain undocumented are shown raw instead of being invented.</div></div></section>
<section class="p2view" data-p2view="patterns">
 <div class="p2toolbar" id="p2transport">
  <button class="primary" id="p2Play">PLAY PATTERN</button><button class="stop" id="p2Stop">STOP</button><button id="p2Clear">CLEAR</button>
  <label>BPM <input id="p2Bpm" type="range" min="40" max="250" value="120"><b id="p2BpmV">120</b></label>
  <label>SWING <input id="p2Swing" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="0"><b id="p2SwingV">0%</b></label>
  <label>LEN <select id="p2Len"><option>16</option><option selected>32</option></select></label>
  <button id="p2Save">SAVE</button><button id="p2LoadBtn">LOAD</button><input type="file" id="p2Load" accept="application/json,.json" hidden>
 </div>
 <div class="p2panel"><div id="p2PatternStatus" class="p2status good">Enhanced sequencer routes every step through the selected machine’s emulated key matrix → original firmware → DM3AG.</div><div class="p2gridwrap"><div class="p2grid" id="p2Grid"></div></div></div>
 <div class="p2panel"><h3>Pattern Library</h3><div class="p2filters" id="p2Filters"></div><div class="p2browser" id="p2Browser"></div></div>
</section>
<section class="p2view" data-p2view="mixer">
 <div class="p2toolbar"><label>MASTER <input id="p2Master" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="85"><b id="p2MasterV">85%</b></label><button id="p2Unmute">UNMUTE ALL</button></div>
 <div class="p2panel"><h3>Enhanced Sequencer Mixer</h3><div class="p2sub">These levels/pans apply to pad hits fired by Pattern Studio. Native firmware playback still follows the original firmware/DM3AG command stream.</div><div class="p2mixer" id="p2Mixer"></div></div>
</section>
<section class="p2view" data-p2view="voices">
 <div class="p2toolbar"><button data-fwshortcut="VOICE">VOICE</button><button data-fwshortcut="TUNE">TUNE</button><button data-fwshortcut="MIX">MIX</button><span class="p2sub">Hardware shortcuts hit the real firmware controls.</span></div>
 <div class="p2panel"><h3>Firmware Pad Audition</h3><div class="p2voices" id="p2Voices"></div></div>
</section>
<section class="p2view" data-p2view="settings">
 <div class="p2panel"><h3>Firmware / Studio Settings</h3><div class="p2status" id="p2Diag">Loading diagnostics…</div><div class="p2footerNote">A machine's native pattern 00 may be empty, so its hardware PLAY button can legitimately be silent until that firmware has pattern data. Pattern Studio fires the selected machine's real emulated key matrix, so loaded patterns still make that machine's original OS generate DM3AG commands.</div></div>
</section>

<section class="p2view sy-view" data-p2view="synth" aria-label="Analog polyphonic synthesizer">
 <div class="sy-topline"><div class="sy-heading">ANALOG POLY</div><div class="sy-tag">8 VOICES • 2 VCO • PWM • 24 dB VCF • ANALOG DRIVE • CLOCK-LOCKED ARP</div><div class="sy-actions"><select id="syPreset" aria-label="Synth patch preset"></select><button id="sySave">EXPORT</button><button id="syLoadBtn">IMPORT</button><input id="syLoad" type="file" accept=".json,application/json" hidden></div></div>
 <div class="sy-bankbar"><label>BANK <select id="syBank" aria-label="Patch bank"><option>A</option><option>B</option><option>C</option><option>D</option></select></label><label>SLOT <select id="sySlot" aria-label="Patch slot"><option value="1">1</option><option value="2">2</option><option value="3">3</option><option value="4">4</option></select></label><label>NAME <input id="syPatchName" type="text" maxlength="25" placeholder="Patch name" aria-label="Patch name"></label><button id="syStore">STORE PATCH</button><button id="syRecall">RECALL PATCH</button><span id="syBankInfo">16 patch memories</span></div>
 <div class="sy-transport"><button id="syPlay" class="sy-active">▶ PLAY DRUMS + SYNTH</button><button id="syStop">■ STOP</button><button id="syPanic">ALL NOTES OFF</button><button id="syMIDI">CONNECT MIDI</button><div class="sy-bpm" id="syClock">120 BPM • 32 STEPS</div></div>
 <div class="sy-status" id="syStatus">READY</div>
 <div class="sy-panelrow" id="syPanels"></div>
 <div class="sy-keypanel"><div class="sy-keyheader"><h3>PLAYABLE KEYBOARD</h3><div class="sy-keycontrols"><button id="syOctDown" aria-label="Octave down">− OCT</button><b id="syOctaveLabel">C3 – B4</b><button id="syOctUp" aria-label="Octave up">+ OCT</button></div><span class="sy-kbdhelp">TOUCH / POINTER • PC: Z–M + Q–U</span></div><div class="sy-keyscroll"><div class="sy-keys" id="syKeys"></div></div></div>
 <div class="sy-seqpanel"><div class="sy-seqheader"><h3>POLYPHONIC NOTE SEQUENCER</h3><div class="sy-actions"><button id="syDemo">CHORD DEMO</button><button id="syClear">CLEAR NOTES</button><button id="syRecord" class="sy-rec" aria-pressed="false">● STEP RECORD</button><label style="font:700 11px Arial">GATE <select id="syGate"><option value="50">50%</option><option value="85" selected>85%</option><option value="150">150%</option><option value="240">240%</option><option value="340">340%</option><option value="375">375%</option></select></label></div></div><div class="sy-seqscroll"><div class="sy-grid" id="syGrid"></div></div><div class="sy-seqfoot">CLICK NOTES INTO EACH STEP • UP TO 8 NOTES PER STEP • USE THE MAIN PATTERN CONTROLS FOR BPM, SWING AND 16/32 STEPS • PROJECT SAVE/LOAD INCLUDES DRUMS + SYNTH</div></div>
</section>
<section class="p2view" data-p2view="legacy">
 <div class="p2panel"><h3>Legacy 3-Machine Studio</h3><div class="p2sub">The previous recreation remains preserved here for comparison. The Machine tab now runs the original HR-16, HR-16B, and SR-16 firmware cores.</div><p><a style="color:#8ed7ef" target="_blank" href="https://rawcdn.githack.com/TVGSDVLGames/Balls-Out/28ef6bd36ba50e0fefb5e3396b0ec4e1ad0929c0/rhythm-lab-live26/index.html">Open previous 3-machine studio in a new tab</a></p></div>
</section>
